NEVER DELETE UNCOMMITTED DATA.
Decision: Desktop Commander is the primary machine route.

Correction: the 6KB threshold theory was not supported by evidence.
Lesson: retrying the identical blocked call causes churn.
Correction: preserve allowed work when another part is restricted.
Decision: route failures are transport failures, not permission failures.
RULE: stale saved context must not silently override current instruction.
PROVEN: module-only build passed before the full target validation.
Do not treat stale handoff text as live authority.
Lesson: missing source coverage must remain explicit instead of being inferred away.
